verses.text: Praise waiteth for thee, O God, in Zion; And unto thee shall the vow be performed.

segments.text: Praise waiteth for thee, O God, in Zion;
And unto thee shall the vow be performed.

verses.text: O thou that hearest prayer, Unto thee shall all flesh come.

segments.text: O thou that hearest prayer,
Unto thee shall all flesh come.

verses.text: Iniquities prevail against me: As for our transgressions, thou wilt forgive them.

segments.text: Iniquities prevail against me:
As for our transgressions, thou wilt forgive them.

verses.text: Blessed is the man whom thou choosest, and causest to approach unto thee, That he may dwell in thy courts: We shall be satisfied with the goodness of thy house, Thy holy temple.

segments.text: Blessed is the man whom thou choosest, and causest to approach
unto thee
That he may dwell in thy courts:
We shall be satisfied with the goodness of thy house,
Thy holy temple.

verses.text: By terrible things thou wilt answer us in righteousness, O God of our salvation, Thou that art the confidence of all the ends of the earth, And of them that are afar off upon the sea:

segments.text: By terrible things thou wilt answer us in righteousness,
O God of our salvation,
Thou that art the confidence of all the ends of the earth,
And of them that are afar off upon the sea:

verses.text: Who by his strength setteth fast the mountains, Being girded about with might;

segments.text: Who by his strength setteth fast the mountains,
Being girded about with might;

verses.text: Who stilleth the roaring of the seas, The roaring of their waves, And the tumult of the peoples.

segments.text: Who stilleth the roaring of the seas,
The roaring of their waves,
And the tumult of the peoples.

verses.text: They also that dwell in the uttermost parts are afraid at thy tokens: Thou makest the outgoings of the morning and evening to rejoice.

segments.text: They also that dwell in the uttermost parts are afraid at thy tokens:
Thou makest the outgoings of the morning and evening to rejoice.

verses.text: Thou visitest the earth, and waterest it, Thou greatly enrichest it; The river of God is full of water: Thou providest them grain, when thou hast so prepared the earth.

segments.text: Thou visitest the earth, and waterest it,
Thou greatly enrichest it;
The river of God is full of water:
Thou providest them grain, when thou hast so prepared the earth.

verses.text: Thou waterest its furrows abundantly; Thou settlest the ridges thereof: Thou makest it soft with showers; Thou blessest the springing thereof.

segments.text: Thou waterest its furrows abundantly;
Thou settlest the ridges thereof:
Thou makest it soft with showers;
Thou blessest the springing thereof.

verses.text: Thou crownest the year with thy goodness; And thy paths drop fatness.

segments.text: Thou crownest the year with thy goodness;
And thy paths drop fatness.

verses.text: They drop upon the pastures of the wilderness; And the hills are girded with joy.

segments.text: They drop upon the pastures of the wilderness;
And the hills are girded with joy.

verses.text: The pastures are clothed with flocks; The valleys also are covered over with grain; They shout for joy, they also sing.

segments.text: The pastures are clothed with flocks;
The valleys also are covered over with grain;
They shout for joy, they also sing.

headings.text: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm. A Song of David.
